The camera is on the powdery ground clear of the column, level with a standing man's eye and six long strides from the nearest wheel, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera. At 00:04 the dust rolls up behind the wheels and spreads, and the roll continues to the last frame of the shot. Behind him some twenty pale-faced women in plain bonnets walk beside the wheels carrying bundles, and small children walk at their skirts or look out from under the white canvas, from 00:00 to 00:08.
